name: KOMPEITO Inc.
summary: KOMPEITO, Inc. operates as a employee-benefit food services centered on OFFICE DE YASAI, a placed, self-service healthy food program that stocks salads, boxed lunches, and other healthy meals in office refrigerators and freezers for employees to purchase anytime. The company was founded by Ryozo Kawagishi and Shun Watanabe in September 2012 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
